observations: White game console with a black diagonal split in the faceplates, characteristic of the PlayStation 5 Slim model.
The PlayStation logo is visible on the top left of the front faceplate in photo 0.
The console is wrapped in a thin, clear plastic film.
A red/pink DualSense wireless controller is positioned in front of the console.
Rear ports visible in photo 1 include HDMI, LAN, two USB-A ports, and a power input.
The console is shown in a vertical orientation.
Watermarks 'JAYCYPHER GAMES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on both images.
The right side of the console (where a disc drive would be) is not clearly shown in a way that confirms its presence or absence.

claims.evidence: The PlayStation logo is visible in photo 0 and the hardware design matches the PS5 Slim.
The console is not shown powered on, and the plastic wrap may obscure surface scratches.

risks.risk: The console may be the Digital Edition or the Disc Edition (price difference).
risks.proof: A photo of the front/side showing the presence or absence of a disc slot.

risks.risk: The console may have internal hardware failure or be banned from the PlayStation Network.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and successfully connecting to the PlayStation Store.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu or in a controller test application.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the front and side of the console to confirm if it has a disc drive.
A video of the console powered on and connected to a screen, showing the dashboard and a connection to the PSN store.
A photo of the model and serial number label located on the bottom or back of the unit.
response.reason: The photos do not show the side of the console where the disc drive would be, making it impossible to distinguish between the Disc and Digital models. Additionally, there is no proof of functionality.
